field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Actual executable local model identities; keep historical models in hashed sidecars.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Each completeness/value check names expected, observed, passed and principle.
field_principles.baseline_validation_failures: Keep unrelated nonzero suite receipts separate from the passing changed-scope gates.
field_principles.board_continuity_complete_score: One for all three authenticated per-board dispositions, independent of individual physical readiness.
field_principles.board_disposition_complete_score: One means three authenticated dispositions and exact next conditions are present.
field_principles.board_rows: KV260, PolarFire and GateMate evidence hashes, actual venue, capability and next condition.
field_principles.changed_state_receipt: Observed dated operator receipt or explicit absent value, never inferred from elapsed time.
field_principles.completed_at_utc: Record the actual UTC end timestamp.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured monotonic elapsed and disjoint phase spans, including failures and initialization.
field_principles.execution_host: Record the real hostname separately from the closed venue vocabulary.
field_principles.execution_venue: Host is host; identify actual GPU/native/device execution separately.
field_principles.field_principles: Store explanations here while consumer values remain ordinary top-level values.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Each blocked board names its failed physical check and observed value; no alternate diagnostic field.
field_principles.generation_count: Count only generations made by this invocation.
field_principles.hardware_operations_issued: Exactly zero for this read-only task.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Complete findings start complete_ or complete:; external absence starts blocked_; state the actual finding.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use the recognized literal for actual computation; never infer from intended task.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Full generation60s, bounded10s, load-only2s, or actual no-LLM class; never pad elapsed time.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted/completed/failed loads and generation; retain in-flight events on timeout.
field_principles.model_invocation_count: Count only model calls made by this invocation.
field_principles.model_invoked: True for any actual attempted model load or generation, including failed and unusable work.
field_principles.model_load_count: Count only model loads made by this invocation.
field_principles.operator_state_receipt: Only a real later physical-state change can enable a future GateMate probe.
field_principles.phase_spans_s: Retain the disjoint measured phase spans that make up the invocation.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Hash actual inputs, authority boundaries, resource ownership and failed checks.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze development and independent evaluation seeds before observing outcomes.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, config, inputs, model identity if any and immutable raw evidence.
field_principles.rows: Every comparative unit/arm/seed with metric, cost, error, abstention and censoring; no aggregate-only claim.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260914, real UTC start/end and monotonic timing.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Planned, attempted, complete and censored units plus the frozen stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the artifact; retain ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Keep exact producer identities, terminal classes, retirement and quarantine state.
field_principles.spec_refs: Connect the artifact and tests to REQ-ISING-7300 scenarios.
field_principles.started_at_utc: Record the actual UTC start timestamp.
field_principles.status: Use a terminal complete or blocked record; unfinished own work belongs in separate checkpoints.
field_principles.task_id: Bind this receipt to the exact V641 roadmap task.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Command, exit code, elapsed time and log hash; preserve actual failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Exactly positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Oracle=true forbids positive; failed efficacy gates forbid positive. Only own unfinished work is partial; unchanged external failure is terminal blocked.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Expose shared verifier/evaluator authority; same-authority mechanics are not learned correctness.
